title: File Indexing Regression: Broken Path Resolution Beyond Top-Level Directory
body:
**Bug Description**
In the 1.0.69 version my files are no longer being indexed properly. I can't @my-file/path anymore. It is only recognizing like top level files

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 1.0.69
- Feedback ID: cd894f96-e4dc-45f5-9a16-20089792ef9a

**Errors**
```json

```

top_comments.body:
+1 this is also happening to me after update to v1.0.69. This makes claude code pretty unsusable in large repos and it's not the first time it happens.

EDIT: Confirmed downgrading to v1.0.68 fixes the issue
